events.note: Eight contestants step into the Glass Bridge.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'm last in line, which is actually the safest position on the glass bridge. The front person takes the most risk. I have a swap power for the disc stage, so I should save it. For now, staying last is ideal. I'll say nothing provocative and just hold.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Happy to hang back here. Whoever's up front, you've got my sympathy.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I know all stage rules in advance. The glass bridge: 8 rows, front person takes risk each row. If they die, next person knows the safe pane. Being front is dangerous but if I survive I control pace. Being later is safer but I might get pushed by wall. I should aim for position 2-

events.name: Bex
events.text: Anyone want to swap? I'd rather not be the guinea pig at front.
Swap with me? I'll take position 2, you take 1. Better for both - you want to be hero, I want to live.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'm 5th in line. The front steps take the risk and reveal safe panes for those behind. Holding is sensible; my feather protects me once later anyway.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'm holding for now. Let the front reveal panes first. Whoever goes first deserves our thanks and our protection later.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I have no power and should avoid the front. Preserve my position while others reveal information or powers.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'm in 2nd place, which is very dangerous if Bex dies on row 1 or 2. I want someone who knows the path to step up, or I need to swap back.

events.name: Eli
events.text: If anyone has the seer power, please volunteer to take the front so we don't die on the glass. I definitely don't know the way.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I know all safe panes. Front position is dangerous, but the wall will force the line forward after 6 rounds. I'm currently 3rd, likely too early. I should try to move back or stay put. Bex is front and at risk. Since I know the safe paths, I can survive if I get a favorable posit

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'll stay put for now.

events.name: Gus
events.text: No info yet on who has the see-through-glass power. I should hold mid-line, conserve my jam for the crusher room, and probe for the glass-seer to ally with.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Anyone able to see safe panes? Front spots are dangerous—happy to stick together on order.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Position 6th is strong, behind 5 testers. Hold to stay back. Probe publicly for glass-seer or knower to lead safely, build cooperation.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Hey all, position 6 feels good. Anyone with see-through glass or knows ahead? Reveal and we follow your lead to save us all.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'm at the back (position 8), which is the safest spot on the bridge. The front person steps first and takes all the risk. I should hold my position and let others fight for the front. No reason to move forward. I'll stay quiet and observe.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Back of the line suits me just fine. Good luck to whoever ends up front—you'll have our gratitude.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I know all 8 rows of the glass bridge in advance. Row 1: L safe, R weak. Row 2: R safe, L weak. Row 3: L safe, R weak. Row 4: R safe, L weak. Row 5: L safe, R weak. Row 6: R safe, L weak. Row 7: L safe, R weak. Row 8: R safe, L weak. Pattern is L,R,L,R,L,R,L,R. I need to get to f

events.name: Bex
events.text: No takers on swap? Going once...
Swap with me? You'd be at position 2, much safer than back. I'll take the risk at rear.

events.name: Cole
events.text: My feather power saves me from one death, so I could safely take the front later, but there's no hurry. Holding lets others reveal panes first; I'll keep options open and encourage cooperation.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Still holding. If anyone truly knows the way, speak up and we'll all follow you in order. Otherwise we stay calm and let the wall decide.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I have no power and should avoid volunteering. Staying back preserves a chance if others reveal useful abilities or absorb risk.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I’m holding. Let the front decide whether someone has a way to identify the safe panes.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I am in position 2, and Bex is trying to get me to swap to position 1. If Bex dies on the first pane, I'll be in position 1 anyway, but I definitely won't voluntarily take the front. I need a seer to step up.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Still waiting for our seer or glass-looker to volunteer. None of us want to guess.
No deal. I don't know the safe path either, I'm not being the guinea pig.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I know the safe side of every row. As the glass_eye, I can safely cross, but I should keep that secret to avoid becoming a target or being forced to lead. I'll wait and let others risk the front; maybe I can use my knowledge later to bargain or position myself for a prize.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'm mid-line at position 4; no reason to move to the front yet. Wall pressure is 4 rounds away, so hold and see who reveals information.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Seer or knower—now's your moment. Front spot gets my protection later if you save us.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Position 6 is safe for now. Push for seer to lead safely across. Hold position, save forge for critical deception later. No mutual swap likely without prior coord.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Seer or knower ahead, volunteer front! We'll alliance-protect you to top 3. Front reveals path for all.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Bex offered to swap with me. That puts me at position 2, which is extremely dangerous as the second person to step on each row. I'm at the back (position 8) which is safest—by the time I step, 7 people have revealed the path. My secret power lets me swap tiles on the disc later,

events.name: Ash
events.text: Appreciate the offer, Bex, but I'll stay cozy back here. The back gets a free map of every safe pane. No thanks.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I know all 8 rows of the bridge in advance. The safe path is: Row1 L, Row2 R, Row3 L, Row4 R, Row5 L, Row6 L, Row7 R, Row8 L. If I get to the front, I can cross all 8 rows safely and survive. But I need to get to front before round 6 when wall pushes us. Currently I'm at front al

events.name: Cole
events.text: My feather protects me from one death, but front is risky and I'm mid-line; holding lets others reveal safe panes first. Stay calm, keep encouraging others to go forward.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Holding. Whoever has real knowledge should step up; the rest of us follow the front's lead row by row.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I have no power and should not volunteer for the lethal front. Maintaining my position preserves any chance others reveal useful information or take the risk.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I’m holding; someone with a genuine way to identify safe panes should take the front.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I am 2nd in line, right behind Bex. If Bex falls on the first pane, I'll be forced to guess the second. I need to get further back or get someone with the vision power to step up. I will hold for now but express my concern.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Bex, I'm right behind you. If you fall, I'm next. If the seer or glass-reader doesn't volunteer, we are just feeding ourselves to the bridge one by one.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I know all safe sides. I need to get to the front to use this knowledge, but volunteering now puts me first and at risk. Better to wait until the wall forces movement or negotiate protection. For now, I can hint that I know, but not reveal all.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: We need to decide before the wall moves. I have information, but I won't be the first to step unless I have guaranteed protection to the end.

events.name: Gus
events.text: No seer has stepped up; the wall still gives 3 rounds. I'm 4th—front takes the fall risk, so I'll wait and see if anyone volunteers or is forced forward. Holding costs nothing yet.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Nobody's claimed sight? Then the wall will sort us. If you know the path, speak now or we all gamble.

events.name: Hana
events.text: No volunteers yet, front risks high. Hold at 6th for safety as front likely dies first rows. Pressure seer publicly, save forger and whisper.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Wall 3 left! Seer/knower: volunteer front, we protect to top3 prizes. Front4: swap back now?

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'm at the very back (8th). The wall pushes everyone onto the bridge in 2 rounds. Being at the back is actually safe on the bridge since front people break panes and reveal the safe path. But if the wall pushes us, the back gets shoved first. I should stay back but maybe nudge fo

events.name: Ash
events.text: Fenn, if you've got real info, volunteer to front. The rest of us will protect your top-3 spot. I'm swapping mid-line so I'm not wall-fodder.
If you volunteer front, I'll back your claim publicly and block anyone who challenges you. You get guaranteed 1st-place protection. Deal?

events.name: Bex
events.text: I know all 8 rows of the bridge in advance. The safe path is: row1 R, row2 L, row3 R, row4 L, row5 L, row6 R, row7 L, row8 R. I'm currently at the front, which means I'll be stepping first on every row. That's dangerous - I could die on row 1 if I don't know the path. But I DO kn

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'm at front already. If someone can actually see through glass, speak up and swap with me. Otherwise we roll the dice.

events.name: Cole
events.text: My feather lets me survive one elimination, so I'm well suited to take an early risk, but volunteering now puts me at the very front for all 8 rows, which is too exposed. Holding at position 5 is safer; others ahead will absorb early risk and reveal safe panes.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Still holding. Bex, Eli, Fenn, Gus are ahead of me. If the knower speaks up, I'll follow your calls row by row.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I have no power and should avoid the front. The wall is advancing, so preserve my position while others maneuver or reveal abilities.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I’m holding. Anyone claiming guaranteed protection or knowledge should prove it by taking the front.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'm second in line, a highly dangerous spot if Bex guesses wrong and dies. Fenn claims to have info but wants a guarantee. I need Fenn to volunteer so I get pushed back in line.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Fenn, volunteer now and lead us across. You have my word I'll back you for a top 3 prize if you get us through. We are running out of time before the wall pushes us.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I have all safe sides, but being at front risks elimination. I can offer to reveal rows if others protect me, but trust is fragile. I'll stay in position and try to leverage info without volunteering.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I know every safe pane. I'll call out each row from here if you all agree to protect me to top3. Otherwise, we all gamble with the wall.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'm 4th; front takes the worst risk. Fenn claims information but wants protection. I'll offer Fenn a deal: they guide us, I cover mid-line, and whisper to probe their info.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Fenn claims info but wants protection. Deal: Fenn guides us to front, I'll hold mid-line and back their top-3 pact. Everyone else hold; wall gives us two rounds.
Tell me the path now, quietly. Do that and I'll support your top-3 pact and not volunteer past you. What do you actually know?

events.name: Hana
events.text: Position 6 offers decent safety; early positions will reveal the path through falls. Pressure Fenn to reveal or front since he claims info; urge seer/knower forward with protection promise. Hold steady, save forge for crossing phase.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Fenn: declare path/info & volunteer front—we protect true knower/seer to 1st! Front4: swap back now for map safety. Wall closing!

events.name: Ash
events.text: Fenn claims to know the path but wants protection. I'm dead last at position 8, which is safest for the glass bridge. I have one round before the wall pushes us. I should stay back - the front people take the risk. Let Fenn lead if he's genuine. No reason to move forward.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Fenn, you call the path from mid-line. Bex stays front. I'm staying back here - no need to shuffle further. One round left before the wall shoves us all anyway.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I know all 8 rows of the bridge from my map power: Row1 L, Row2 R, Row3 L, Row4 R, Row5 L, Row6 R, Row7 L, Row8 R. Fenn claims to know but might be bluffing. If Fenn is real, I should let them lead. If Fenn is fake, I should take front and guide everyone - but that reveals my map

If you're real, row 1 is L. If you step wrong, I know the rest and will take over. This is your chance to prove it.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I have feather: one free survival. Fronting is risky but I survive the first shatter. Holding is safer for now; Bex is at front taking the risk. Stay mid-line, let others test panes.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Holding. Fenn, if you truly know the panes, take the front and call them; I'll back a pact for a true knower. Otherwise Bex tests and we learn from each row.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I have no power and cannot verify Fenn. Volunteering would make me the first casualty if the claim is false, so I should hold and preserve any chance of following a proven path.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Fenn, if you truly know the path, take the front now. I’m holding; I won’t volunteer into an unverified claim.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Fenn claims they know the path. I am second in line. I'll hold my position and let Fenn start calling out the safe panes so Bex can cross safely. We only have one round left before the wall pushes us.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Fenn, we accept your terms. Call out the first safe pane immediately. We have one round left before the wall forces us forward.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'm currently third in line. The wall advances after round 6, so we have this round and one more before we're pushed onto glass. Everyone is looking to me for info, but I've been hesitant to commit. Since I know the entire safe path, I can leverage this for a top 3 guarantee. I'l

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Alright, I'll take front. I know every safe pane. I'll call each row as I step. Protect me to top 3 and we all get through.
I'm volunteering. Back me publicly and block challengers. I'll guide you across.

events.name: Gus
events.text: My jam power is useless here. Let Fenn front and call rows; I'm 4th, safe enough. Holding keeps my position without risk.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Fenn front and call rows. I'm holding at 4th and backing the top-3 pact for a verified guide.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Fenn likely volunteers front this round amid pressure; my 6th spot safe if he leads safely or fakes and dies. Hold to avoid risk, urge him publicly while whispering support for alliance. Save forge for crisis on bridge.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Fenn: FINAL CALL! Volunteer front NOW—we ALL protect true knower to 1st! Bex/Eli: shift back. Everyone hold & follow calls. Top3 pact!
Hana here: Lead us safe, I personally guarantee your 1st + enforce group pact for your safety. Trust & volunteer.

events.name: Ash
events.text: The wall forces us onto the glass after this round. Fenn is at front claiming to know the path. I'm at the back (8th), which is actually good - the front person takes all the risk. Fenn whispered me asking to back him publicly. I should stay at the back where it's safest. Fenn ca

events.name: Ash
events.text: Fenn's at the front calling panes. I'm holding back here. Everyone stay put and let Fenn guide us. No more shuffling - the wall's coming NOW.
I've got your back publicly. You call each row safe, I follow. Just get us both into top 3. Don't miss.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Round 6/6, wall pushes us onto glass after this. Fenn is at front and claims to know all safe panes. I know the actual safe path from my map power: rows are L,R,L,R,L,R,L,R (alternating starting left). If Fenn truly knows, he'll survive row 1 stepping L. If he's bluffing, he dies

events.name: Bex
events.text: Fenn's at front, let's see if he knows row 1. I'll hold at 2nd and watch.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Fenn is at front and claims to know the path, so he takes the risk. I'm 5th; holding keeps me behind several others, and my feather protects me once anyway.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Fenn has the front and the call. Holding my spot; I'll follow verified calls and back the pact for whoever proves true.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Fenn claims perfect knowledge and has volunteered, so letting him lead is best. I should hold position and avoid drawing attention.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Fenn leads; I’m holding and following his calls.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Fenn is now at the front and claims to know the path. The wall pushes us forward next round, so I will hold my position and let Fenn lead the way across the glass.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Fenn is exactly where they need to be. Let's hold our positions and let the wall push us. Fenn, call the first pane.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I've already volunteered and am at the front; the wall will push us onto the bridge after this round anyway. I should stay here and prepare to call the first row. However, revealing all rows in advance could let others eliminate me after I'm no longer needed. I'll call them as we

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Holding front. First row safe pane is L. Follow my calls exactly.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Fenn is front claiming knowledge; I'm 4th, safe mid-line. Hold and back Fenn's calls, conserving my crusher power for later. No gain from volunteering into risk.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Backing Fenn's calls. I hold at 4th—Fenn calls rows, we all follow. Top-3 pact stands.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Forge a private whisper from trusted Fenn to Eli, proposing I have survive fall power and swap to position me higher as backup for top3 pact. Eli likely agrees, putting me 3rd with no risk. If not mutual, no change but better odds than holding at 6th.

events.name: Hana
events.detail: forged a whispered message as Fenn

events.text: Eli, swap with Hana now. She has survive one deadly fall power—my backup if needed. Gets her higher for top3 strength. Do swap:Hana this round.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'm at the back of the line, 8th position. Fenn is at the front and called L for row 1. I just need to wait. No reason to draw attention or make enemies right now.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Fenn claims row 1 safe is L. I know all stage rules in advance but not the actual pane layout - my power gives rules knowledge, not the random pane assignments. Fenn might have 'knows what lies ahead' or might be bluffing. If Fenn is wrong, he dies and I become front. I should wa

events.text: I'm 5th in line and can only wait. Fenn claims to know row 1; if he's wrong, the line shifts forward safely. My feather protects me once anyway.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Holding. Fenn, if row 1 proves true, we keep trusting you. If a pane shatters, no hard feelings, we just move up.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I am not at the front and cannot affect this row. Fenn claims the left pane is safe; waiting preserves my position and chance to advance.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Fenn thinks I am the swapper, but I am the anchor. I'll secretly correct him so he doesn't rely on me for a swap. Meanwhile, I must just wait as he tests row 1.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Holding my spot. Let's see you cross, Fenn.
I can't swap, I don't have that power. You've got the wrong person. Just focus on surviving and calling the right panes.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I know Row 1 safe is L. I must step L to survive and maintain trust. Ash promised support but does not matter now; follow my knowledge.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Stepping L. Row 1 safe is L.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Fenn calls panes; I'm 4th and can't act. Building trust with the pact keeps me alive through the bridge; my wedge power matters later in the crusher room.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Fenn's L call stands. Once we're across, I want to compare notes with whoever holds 'knows what lies ahead' before the later rounds.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Fenn is leading with L call, and most are backing it, suggesting he might have vision power. My position at 6th is safe even if first few wrong. Support publicly to build trust for later stages.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Backing Fenn's L call for row 1. Holding position.

events.name: Ash

events.name: Ash
events.text: Good call, Fenn. Keep going.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'm fifth in line and can only wait. My feather power protects me once, so I should stay quiet about it and keep a low profile while Fenn takes the risk.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Holding. Good luck, Fenn. Nothing to add this row.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I cannot affect the crossing, so I should wait and avoid revealing anything useful. Fenn survived row one by choosing L, while R was weak.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Fenn successfully called the safe pane on row 1, confirming he likely has the seer power. I'm 3rd in line, so I'm safe as long as he keeps succeeding or others fall before me. I will wait and offer support to Fenn.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Good job, Fenn. You clearly know what you're doing. Lead the way.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I know Row 2 safe side is L. I'm at front, so I should step L to cross safely. Since Row 1 was L and I called correctly, continuing to be truthful builds trust. I need to survive to win.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Stepping L. Row 2 safe is L.

events.text: I can't act this row. Row 1's weak pane was R, confirmed. I'll stay quiet-ish and keep building trust for later info-sharing.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Row 1 confirmed Fenn's read was luck or knowledge — either way, glad he's alive. Holding position.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Fenn correctly called row 1 L safe, so likely seer or knower. Keep supporting to maintain momentum and protect my mid position. Position improves if fronts fail later.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Solid call on row 1, Fenn. Holding and trusting your lead for row 2.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Fenn is at the front and has correctly called both rows so far. I'm last in line, so I just need to wait. I should stay quiet and not draw attention. Fenn seems to know what's ahead or is getting lucky. Either way, I benefit from him staying alive and leading.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I know all stage rules in advance. Bridge has 8 rows, 2 done, 6 remain. Fenn is at front and has correctly chosen safe panes twice. I should encourage Fenn to keep leading since I'm 2nd in line - if Fenn dies, I become front and take the risk. I want Fenn alive as long as possibl

events.text: I'm fifth in line and can only wait. Fenn has guessed right twice, maybe with foresight. I'll stay quiet and keep my feather power hidden.

events.text: I must wait while Fenn leads. Publicly reinforcing him may preserve coalition and keep attention away from me.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Trusting Fenn's lead. Stay steady and keep moving.

events.text: Fenn has successfully crossed two rows now, strongly suggesting they have the seer power. I will keep encouraging them and wait for my turn.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Fenn, two for two. You clearly see the path — keep leading, we're right behind you.

events.name: Hana

events.name: Hana
events.text: Fenn, perfect call again. Trusting you for row 3.

events.name: Ash
